merge_memcpy.note: encode() builds each merge candidate with strlen and memcpy instead of sprintf("%s%s"), and skips the vocabulary lookup when the pair is longer than max_token_length (no token can match it). Tokens are unchanged.

rope_once.note: A real but small improvement, kept to show a candidate below min_effect is refused: measured 0.77% fewer instructions (ratio 0.99229) on forward_ir with -ffp-contract=off builds, against the 1% min_effect. forward() computes the RoPE cos/sin rotation for this position once per call (it depends only on pos and the head offset) instead of once per layer, and the attention scale sqrtf(head_size) once instead of per timestep. The same float expressions are evaluated, so logits are bit-identical.

matmul_rows4.note: matmul computes four output rows per pass over x, each with its own accumulator that adds the same products in the same order as before (so results are bit-identical), loading each x[j] once for four rows and cutting loop overhead; a tail loop handles d not divisible by 4.
